# Manual Account Hub editing sets a different Back destination from protocol selection

With the new manual flow enabled, editing a found configuration overrides the manual form previousStep to emailConfigFoundSubview. Continuing from protocol selection uses the default protocolSelectSubview target. The actual Back-event consumer initializes that stored previousStep. The regression checks visibility along both routes with IMAP; it does not assert focus, accessibility output or every protocol. Later accepted options and hostname clearing remain separate source phases. No browser test ran.

Scope: Account Hub manual configuration navigation.
